description: Doors; ticket scanning; guest list; will-call; crowd count; artist settlement at the end of the night
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: A show cannot be moved once doors are set; about $2,500 in tickets and the bar share depend on each night; the artist guarantee is owed even if the show fails; crowd count matters for the fire code capacity; RPO 0 because scans must match tickets sold
manual_workaround: Scanner app works offline with the attendee list downloaded before doors; printed attendee list and hand count at the door; settlement from the last SYS-01 sales report printed before doors
dependent_systems: SYS-01; SYS-07 (scanning phones and the owner's phone); SYS-08
dependent_third_parties: Ticketing platform vendor; door and security contractor; landlord (building internet)
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner (single point of failure: the only person who can run settlement and the guest list); the Room

description: Event setup; online and walk-up sales on the hosted checkout; phone orders (to become payment links); pricing; refunds; payouts
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: On an on-sale day an outage of more than 2 hours loses most first-day sales and fans; on other days sales can wait a day; RPO 0 because the vendor holds every order and payment (vendor commitments in its SOC 2 report, P09)
manual_workaround: Postpone an on-sale and announce the new time; for show-night walk-ups, queue buyers and sell after recovery
dependent_third_parties: Ticketing platform vendor; payment processor; website builder
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner (single point of failure); marketing assistant for announcements

description: Event announcements; website calendar; email campaigns; social posts; answering fan questions
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Sales depend on announcements in the 3 to 6 weeks before a show; a hijacked social account or website can mislead fans; fee-display rules apply to every post (P03)
manual_workaround: Announce from the ticketing platform's own event pages and the owner's personal social account; answer fans by email
dependent_third_parties: Website builder; email marketing service; social media platforms

description: Artist offers and contracts; deposits and settlements; riders; hold calendar
rpo_hours: Agents expect replies within days; deposits have contract due dates; a missed or misdirected payment damages agent relationships; contracts live in email and cloud files
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Phone the agent; confirm payment instructions by phone before any transfer; work from the copies in cloud storage
dependent_systems: Productivity suite vendor; accounting SaaS; bank

description: Bookkeeping; sales tax; processor portal (chargebacks and SAQ); insurance; lease
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Deadlines are measured in days or weeks (chargeback replies, the SAQ due 2026-10-31, quarterly tax filings)
manual_workaround: Use the bank's and processor's own portals; paper copies of the lease and insurance in the office
dependent_third_parties: Accounting SaaS; outside bookkeeper; payment processor
